import os, subprocess, json, glob, time

drive='.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py'
env=os.environ.copy();
env.update({
  'DRIVE_SESSION_TAG':'nothingness_linux_debug',
  'DRIVE_TARGET':'linux',
  'DRIVE_RUN_LOG':'/tmp/flutter_run_nothingness_linux_debug.log',
  'DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO':'/tmp/flutter_input_nothingness_linux_debug',
  'DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME':'/tmp/nothingness_nothingness_linux_debug',
})
fixtures=sorted(glob.glob('/opt/nothingness/media/*.opus'))
assert len(fixtures)==10
fixture_set=set(fixtures)

def parse_json_output(out: str):
    s=out.strip(); first=s.find('{'); last=s.rfind('}')
    return json.loads(s[first:last+1])

def run(args, timeout=120):
    out=subprocess.check_output([drive]+args, env=env, text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
    return parse_json_output(out)

paths_csv=','.join(fixtures)
run(['call','ext.nothingness.setQueue',f'paths={paths_csv}','startIndex=0'])

run(['settings','open'])
run(['tap','void-settings-status-shuffle'])

time.sleep(0.5)

st=run(['inspect'])
for _ in range(40):
    if st['playback'].get('shuffle') is True:
        break
    time.sleep(0.12)
    st=run(['inspect'])
else:
    raise RuntimeError('shuffle not enabled')

if not st['playback'].get('isPlaying'):
    run(['resume'])
    for _ in range(40):
        st=run(['inspect'])
        if st['playback'].get('isPlaying'):
            break
        time.sleep(0.12)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('did not play')

playback=st['playback']
before_path=playback['songInfo']['path']
before_idx=playback['currentIndex']
qlen=playback['queueLength']
assert before_path in fixture_set
assert qlen==10
assert playback['isPlaying'] is True
print('before', before_idx, before_path)

# Transition
if before_idx < qlen-1:
    direction='next'; run(['next'])
else:
    direction='prev'; run(['prev'])

for _ in range(60):
    st2=run(['inspect'])
    p2=st2['playback']
    after_path=p2['songInfo']['path'] if p2.get('songInfo') else None
    after_idx=p2.get('currentIndex')
    if after_path and after_path!=before_path:
        break
    time.sleep(0.1)
else:
    raise RuntimeError('no transition')

print('after', after_idx, after_path, 'dir', direction)
assert after_path in fixture_set
assert after_path!=before_path

if direction=='next':
    assert after_idx==before_idx+1
else:
    assert after_idx==before_idx-1

print('OK')
PY
